dispatch.routing: Routing uncertainty NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT resolved: Ability.SMOG (the identifier of this record) routes to SmogStrategy via the registry. EffectEnum.SMOG is a separate identifier (SMOG weather: +15 % dodge, -5 % per Smelly Clay) that SmogStrategy does not use; the strategy places EffectEnum.SMOKE instead.

record.summary: The caster turns toward its target and takes the cone of up to 3 adjacent cells in front of it (facing direction plus its two neighbouring directions, range 1, off-board cells dropped). Each cone cell, occupied or empty, gets the SMOKE board effect; each enemy-team unit standing on a cone cell at cast time takes SPECIAL damage (raw 10/20/40/80 by caster stars; KOFFING 1 star -> 10, WEEZING 2 stars -> 20). The SMOKE effect is also added to whoever stands on the cell (allies included, unless that unit holds Heavy Duty Boots) and to any unit that later walks onto the cell (unless it has IMMUNITY_BOARD_EFFECTS); while a unit has it (and no Heavy Duty Boots) updateAllStatus re-applies Blinded for 1000 ms whenever it is not blinded (not applied under Rune Protect; halved when enraged; reduced by status-duration reductions). A blinded attacker gives its target +0.5 dodge chance on that attack. The board effect has no expiry in addBoardEffect; the callers found that clear it are Tidal Wave, ICE_SPINNER and WATERFALL. Damage is requested raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the target's special-defense division (ceil, min 1) and shield handling inside handleDamage (the returned takenDamage includes shield damage). Name note: the SMOG weather effect (EffectEnum.SMOG) is a different mechanic and is not triggered by this ability.

targeting.who: enemy-team units on the cone cells (damage); every cone cell and its occupant or later visitor (SMOKE effect)
targeting.note: requiresTarget stays true (default): the cast needs a target; the target only fixes the facing direction (it is hit only if it stands on a cone cell).

geometry.shape: cone of up to 3 adjacent cells (facing direction and its two neighbouring directions), range 1; getCellsInFront is called with its default range of 1; off-board cells are dropped

effects.target: each enemy-team unit on a cone cell at cast time

declaredRaw.label: raw special damage by caster stars

effects.scaling: requested = raw x (1 + caster AP/100); x crit factor (1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction) only if the cast rolled a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false); then the target's special-defense division (reducedDamage = damage / (1 + 0.05 x speDef)), ceil, at least 1
effects.resolution: applied: handleSpecialDamage is blocked by protect / skydiving / magicBounce on the target; otherwise handleDamage applies shields and the special-defense division; takenDamage includes shield damage; the strategy ignores the returned values. The cell list carries the occupant read when getCellsInFront was called.

effects.target: each cone cell; its occupant; later visitors

declaredRaw.label: blind duration re-applied by the effect, ms

effects.scaling: fixed; the blinded duration is not AP-scaled (apBoost false, origin null)
effects.resolution: addBoardEffect adds the effect to the occupant unless it holds Heavy Duty Boots, records it on the cell once (the client broadcast happens only the first time); setEntityOnCell moves effects with units (gain on entering unless IMMUNITY_BOARD_EFFECTS, loss on leaving). updateAllStatus blinds a unit with the effect for 1000 ms when it is not blinded and has no Heavy Duty Boots; triggerBlinded does nothing if already blinded or Rune Protect; enraged halves the duration; duration reductions apply. Blinded: the blinded unit's target gets +0.5 dodge chance on its basic attacks. No expiry found: cleared by Tidal Wave, ICE_SPINNER, WATERFALL (other clearing not searched).

statusEffects.target: units standing on or entering a smoked cell (allies and enemies)

starBehavior.note: only the damage depends on stars; the SMOKE effect and cone are star-independent. 3 stars (40) and 4+ (80) are not reachable by the listed units' bare factory stars. maxPP 60 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: Everything depends on the caster's position and on the direction toward the cast target: the affected cells are the up-to-three neighbours in that direction and the two adjacent directions, minus off-board cells. Damage needs an enemy-team unit on the cell at cast time; the SMOKE effect is placed regardless of occupancy.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP, hits the cone again and re-adds SMOKE (a cell already holding it is not re-broadcast; occupants gain it again idempotently).
record.rawVsResolved: Damage: raw 10 (KOFFING) / 20 (WEEZING) x (1 + AP/100) [x crit], then special-defense division (ceil, min 1) and shields in handleDamage; takenDamage counts shield damage. Blind: a recurring 1000 ms Blinded per update while on a smoked cell, subject to Heavy Duty Boots, Rune Protect, enrage halving and duration reductions.
